title: Kähler differentials commute with base change
statement: Let $R\to R'$ and $R\to S$ be homomorphisms of commutative rings and $S'=R'\otimes_RS$, an $R'$-algebra via $r'\mapsto r'\otimes1$. Then there is a unique homomorphism of $R'$-modules $R'\otimes_R\Omega_{S/R}\to\Omega_{S'/R'}$ with $r'\otimes\mathrm ds\mapsto r'\,\mathrm d(1\otimes s)$ ($\Omega$ and $\mathrm d$ as in [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]), and it is an isomorphism; it is $S'$-linear for the $S'$-module structure on $R'\otimes_R\Omega_{S/R}$ given by $(r'_1\otimes s)(r'\otimes\omega)=r'_1r'\otimes s\omega$, so $\Omega_{S'/R'}\cong S'\otimes_S\Omega_{S/R}$ as $S'$-modules.
